comparison_rules: Keep this content identical across A/B/C.
Use a separate fresh fixture with no preference/kept work, and a populated supporting fixture with the one Continue item.
Activity summaries are candidate library copy only, not changes to activity instructions.
Do not add clipboard, automatic voice capture, auto-sending, new saved-work categories, or new activities.
State titles are alternatives, not a list to display all at once.
optional_before_step_04: Share a must-keep brand element or one or two interfaces/illustration styles you love or dislike. No input is required; otherwise explore three distinct visual worlds, including a character-led direction.
